name: otp-field
title: OTP Field
author: Eduardo Retana
description: One-time code field on the input-otp primitive, with animated success and error states and a resend countdown.

meta.descriptionEs: Código de un solo uso sobre la primitiva input-otp, con éxito y error animados y reenvío con cuenta regresiva.

examples.title: Campo OTP
examples.description: Código de un solo uso sobre la primitiva input-otp, con éxito y error animados y reenvío con cuenta regresiva.

api.name: state
api.description: Drives the message and the motion.

api.name: onResend / cooldownSeconds
api.description: Resend stays disabled for the countdown. Default 30 seconds.

api.name: labels
api.description: label, hint, error, success, and resend labels default to English.

api.name: autoFocus / inputMode
api.description: Focus on mount and the keypad mode. Adapted from Arc UI (MIT).

docs: Built on the input-otp primitive. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. Adapted behaviors from Arc UI (MIT) are optional and do not change existing props.
